correctness.rationale: In K_{2,n}, each leaf yields two orientation bits. Only local patterns 10 and 01 are opposite hub-to-hub directed two-paths, and a directed cycle exists exactly when both occur on different leaves. Hence the class is the union of two 3^n product languages with 2^n overlap, giving |A|=2*3^n-2^n. The residual ternary state (u,a,b) has an exact one-query Littlestone recurrence with independent three-state two-bit factors of rank one after a hub-path signature is forced. Strong induction solves the recurrence F=max(u+a,u+b,ceil((3u+a+b)/2)). Initially Ldim=ceil(3n/2). Static shattered coordinates are exactly forests, giving VCdim=n+1. Independent recurrence verified 4096 states and direct concept-class shattering recursion verified n=1..5, with correct orientation counts.
